entities.summary: Mikheil Janelidze is a Georgian politician, who is a chairman of the Center for European Governance & Economy. He previously served as Vice Prime Minister (2017–2018), Minister of Foreign Affairs (2015–2018), First Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs (2015) and Deputy Minister of Economy and Sustainable Development of Georgia (2011-2015).
